"""Mutation harness: model tests must PASS the real implementation and FAIL
each mutant. Portable (sys.executable, list args, -B)."""
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path('ordinals.py')
TEST = 'test_ordinals.py'
MUTANTS = [
    [
        "    if 10 <= n % 100 <= 13:",
        "    if False:"
    ],
    [
        "    suffix = {1: \"st\", 2: \"nd\", 3: \"rd\"}.get(n % 10, \"th\")",
        "    suffix = {1: \"st\", 2: \"nd\", 3: \"rd\"}.get(n % 100, \"th\")"
    ],
    [
        "    if n < 0:",
        "    if n < -1000000:"
    ]
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-q", TEST]
    ).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")

reference_solution.test_ordinals.py:
import pytest

from ordinals import ordinal


def test_basic_suffixes():
    assert ordinal(1) == "1st"
    assert ordinal(2) == "2nd"
    assert ordinal(3) == "3rd"
    assert ordinal(4) == "4th"
    assert ordinal(0) == "0th"


def test_teens_are_th():
    assert ordinal(11) == "11th"
    assert ordinal(12) == "12th"
    assert ordinal(13) == "13th"
    assert ordinal(112) == "112th"


def test_twenties_follow_digit_rule():
    assert ordinal(21) == "21st"
    assert ordinal(22) == "22nd"
    assert ordinal(23) == "23rd"
    assert ordinal(121) == "121st"


def test_negative_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ordinal(-1)
